name: SynergyEffect
rows: Construct or place a Power Plant on a tile adjacent to the left or right of an existing Power Plant.
Construct or place a Daily Supply Station on a tile adjacent to the left or right of the Resource Collection Station.
Construct or place Dorms 2 to 4 on the tiles adjacent to the left or right of Dorm 1.
Construct or place Dispatch Support Stations sequentially on the tiles to the right of the Employment Management Office.
Construct or place Dispatch Support Stations and Employment Support Offices sequentially on the tiles to the right of the Employment Management Office.
Construct or place Armories sequentially on the tiles to the right of the Equipment Production Facility.
Construct or place Power Plants on the tiles adjacent to the left and right of the Energy Conversion Station.
Construct or place Power Plants on the tiles adjacent to the left and right of the Underground Resource Collection Station.
Places an Underground Resource Collection Facility and Energy Conversion Station side by side on the same level or row.
Places a Power Plant MK.III or above in an adjacent cell to the left or right.
